## Findings

- [Minor] lib/closeout-executor.mjs:192 - the unbound occupant guard matches only `a.cwd===entry.cwd` exactly. With the accidental undefined-name match gone, an unnamed agent whose cwd is a subdirectory of the lane (in a workspace not checked out at the lane) is not treated as an occupant, so a clean stopped lane can be removed under it. Use a path-prefix (entry.cwd or entry.cwd + sep) comparison for agents and the pane cwd/foreground_cwd filter.

No Major findings.

## Evidence (read-only)

- Diff: one predicate changed, `a.name===worker?.agent` became `worker?.agent&&a.name===worker.agent`. This matches the pane and terminal clauses beside it, which already check truthiness first.
- Root cause confirmed: retire-runtime.mjs only fetches agent detail when `a.name` is set and passes unnamed rows through without a `name`. With `entry.allocation.worker===null` (the test asserts this), the old code returned `undefined===undefined`, so the allocation was kept.
- The absence-reconcile path at closeout-executor.mjs:295 already skips bounds that are missing agent, session or terminal, so the same pattern is not repeated there.
- Inherited gates: no build, test, check, install or probe was run by this reviewer. Re-executed: [].
